answer: Make sybil resistance come from randomized committee sampling instead of open registration. Each epoch, a public seed sorts every agent into small working groups the way a survey crew parcels a mesa into plots: no identity chooses its neighbors, and a lone attacker cannot concentrate clones where the work is easy. One plot may sit quiet as marble, another busy as a jetty at tide change, but weight comes only from attested work done inside your drawn group, so spawning extra identities just spreads the same effort thinner across useless assignments.
